and component-level innovation must not create unmanaged consequences across other systems.

and near-misses must feed transparent post-incident learning focused on systemic weaknesses rather than blame.

Governance institutions must periodically simplify or remove unnecessary complexity, redundant processes, outdated rules, or excessive dependencies where doing so preserves clarity, operability, and resilience.

but they must not sit outside the Chapter Eleven forum structure.
